numerical_review.rationale: Explicit engineering review of this hashed changed-stack measurement. Short PPL is 3.642167 versus qualified 3.642175 (about -0.0002%); paired mean NLL uncertainty spans zero. BF16-relative mean short KL improves 0.000289 and top1 agreement changes from 490/512 to 492/512, while JS worsens 0.000057, reverse KL and p95 also worsen slightly. These mixed changes are not bit identity or a general quality improvement. The 32K suffix PPL changes from 1.190357 to 1.183419 and all eight BF16-relative top1 probes agree. Independently referenced linear shapes/real weight groups, FP16 SDPA edge cases and all four actual-state attention cases pass their original tolerances. On two actual 64K prefixes, E01 target/sampler distributions and three MTP proposals are bit-identical to qualified v0.31, with independently checked native rejection prefixes. Accept the bounded numerical results as a maintenance candidate; no threshold was widened and the exact check remains failed.
numerical_review.limits: Finite panels and four selected actual-state attention cases. Origin of every short-path array difference is not localized; a matching 64K probe does not make all other prefixes identical. Kernel linear references use the existing gated reconstruction plus independent FP32 transforms/matmul. Quality approval alone is not a release: protected serving, capacity/admission, operational and final frozen benchmark gates remain required.

rationale: Relevant source-verified SDPA ordering fix from the old unpatched micro kernel to stable 3.13.4; actual FP16 micro implementation and Q>1 branch eligibility are documented. No old race reproducer or decode speed gain is claimed.
Original registered rule: no credible >3% critical C1/aggregate-C4 decode loss and no credible >5% protected latency/prefill loss. Every cell passes that rule without threshold changes.

Warm prose-C4 native TPS is -1.776%, aggregate -2.464% (CI [-5.363,0.132]); this smaller adverse effect and its request-counter decomposition remain explicit. Acceptance/counter arithmetic does not uniquely identify a kernel or numeric cause.

The initial unmatched compiler-state source32 penalty remains in the unfiltered eight-block report. The controlled empty-cache pair reproduces ~21-second prefill and 199 blocks on both exact images; ten later ordinary starts match the old 200-block pool. No KV/utilization override.
Quality has a separate explicit numerical review, retaining the failed exact short-array equality receipt and original independent/state tolerances.
limits: This is maintenance-screen approval for remaining exact-image operations and the complete frozen matrix; it is not production release approval.

The wide prose-C4 warm interval cannot rule out >3% loss. The registered no-credible-loss rule is not a formal tight-margin noninferiority proof; finite block counts and cache/scheduling variability remain limits.
Slowest-request-per-wave tails are measured, not a population p99 guarantee. All original favorable and adverse blocks are retained.
Single maximum-context capacity was tested on this runtime image; final metadata must preserve RootFS and all serving parameters. C16 admission still requires its separate operational gate.
